desc: Ideate candidate approaches and select the monotonic-stack contribution method.
Implement an O(1) helper to count positive left/right choices whose combined subarray length is at most k.
Implement sum of minima using monotonic stacks with tie-breaking that assigns each subarray minimum to exactly one equal-valued index.
Implement sum of maxima using mirrored monotonic stacks with consistent tie-breaking.
Combine minima and maxima totals and handle edge cases such as k=1, k=n, duplicates, and negative values.
Validate against sample tests and additional edge cases.
